easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Emissary Green as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to vote for "Profit", creating at least four token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix and Kaya, Geist Hunter.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.name: Kaya, Geist Hunter
uses.cardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
